title: Code structure
text: S3 method replaces mizer’s standard energy-based RDI calculation entirely. call NextMethod(). Instead computes egg production directly gonadic release: r * gonads * n * dw integrates give total gonadic mass released per unit time per species. Dividing egg weight multiplying erepro / 2 (female fraction × reproductive efficiency) converts mass egg numbers. e_growth, mort, e_repro arguments present generic compatibility used.
code: projectRDI.mizerSeasonal <- function(params, n, n_pp, n_other, t = 0,                                      e_growth, mort, e_repro, ...) {     release_func <- get0(other_params(params)$release_func)     r <- release_func(t, params)            # mass-specific release rate (species vector)     total <- drop((sweep(n_other$gonads, 1, r, "*") * n) %*% params@dw)     0.5 * (total * params@species_params$erepro) /         params@w[params@w_min_idx] }

what: Deriving the PDE for gonadic mass
title: Gonadic mass dynamics
text: Standard mizer describes consumer number density \(N(w,t)\) McKendrick-von Foerster equation added diffusion term: \[ \frac{\partial N}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial}{\partial w}\left( g\,N - \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial(d\,N)}{\partial w} \right) = -\mu\,N, \tag{1}\] \(g(w,t)\) somatic growth rate individual size \(w\), \(d(w,t)\) diffusion coefficient, \(\mu(w,t)\) total mortality rate. bracketed term inside spatial derivative total consumer flux \(J_N(w,t) = J_N^{\text{adv}} + J_N^{\text{diff}}\), consisting advective growth flux \(g\,N\) diffusive flux \(-\frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial(d\,N)}{\partial w}\). Instead number density \(N\), describe population somatic biomass density \(B = w\,N\). advection-case (\(d=0\)), differentiating \(B = w\,N\) gives: \[\begin{split} \frac{\partial B}{\partial t} &= w\frac{\partial N}{\partial t} = -w\frac{\partial}{\partial w}\left(g\,\frac{B}{w}\right)-\mu\,B,\\ &=-\frac{\partial}{\partial w}\left(g\,B\right)+g\,\frac{B}{w}-\mu\,B. \end{split}\] intuitive: addition advective transport term \(-\frac{\partial}{\partial w}(g B)\) mortality loss \(-\mu B\), distributed source term \(g B/w = g N\) representing somatic growth occurring within size class. Now consider gonadic mass carried population. Let \(Q(w,t)\) denote total gonadic biomass density across size \(w\) time \(t\), let \(G(w,t)\) gonadic investment rate individual size \(w\) (.e. energy allocated reproduction). mizer, energy available growth reproduction \(E_r\) split somatic growth \(g = E_r(1-\psi)\) reproduction investment \(G= E_r\psi = g\,\psi / (1 - \psi)\), \(\psi(w)\) proportion energy allocated reproduction. mizer code, \(G(w,t)\) corresponds e_repro(w,t). gonadic mass extensive quantity carried individuals \(N\), \(Q(w,t)\) undergoes exact advective transport stochastic size diffusion \(N(w,t)\). addition, \(Q(w,t)\) receives distributed source reproductive investment \(G\,N\), loses mass natural/fishing mortality rate \(\mu\,Q\), releases mass spawning mass-specific release rate \(r(w,t)\): \[ \frac{\partial Q}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial}{\partial w}\left( g\,Q- \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial(d\,Q)}{\partial w} \right) = G\,N - \mu\,Q- r\,Q. \tag{2}\] release rate \(r(w,t)\) encodes seasonality reproduction. terms Equation 2 species-specific, one equation species \(\). Instead total gonadic biomass density \(Q(w,t)\), one might consider average gonadic mass \(q(w,t)\) individual fish size \(w\): \[ q(w,t) = \frac{Q(w,t)}{N(w,t)}. \] Let us derive evolution equation \(q(w,t)\) applying quotient rule \(\frac{\partial q}{\partial t} = \frac{1}{N}\frac{\partial Q}{\partial t} - \frac{Q}{N^2}\frac{\partial N}{\partial t}\).
